name: agent-ai-fastapi
description: Rules, a reviewer and checks for FastAPI services that call LLM providers, in Claude Code, on top of agent-core. Hook: migration-guard refuses hand edits to generated Alembic revisions (folders in .claude/agent-config.json; a repo without one is unaffected). Commands: setup and sync install and verify the backend and Python rules (types, coverage, dead code, providers), a pipeline example, the pre-commit config, quality-gate check scripts and a pull-request-only CI caller. Agent: ai-reviewer. No package.json needed: unlock runs as ./scripts/ops/unlock.sh. The hook runs on your machine, opens no network connection and stays silent until the project opts in.
